name: Elisheba
title: Aaron's wife and matriarch of the priestly line
summary: Elisheba was the daughter of Amminadab and sister to Nahshon, a leader in the tribe of Judah. She married Aaron, Israel's first high priest, and became the mother of four sons who all served as priests. Through her, the priestly line and the royal line were connected.

keyEvents.title: Elisheba's lineage
keyEvents.description: Elisheba was the daughter of Amminadab from the tribe of Judah and the sister of Nahshon, who was the leader of the tribe of Judah during the wilderness journey.

keyEvents.title: Marriage to Aaron
keyEvents.description: She married Aaron, Moses' brother, whom God chose to be Israel's first high priest.

keyEvents.title: Mother of four priestly sons
keyEvents.description: Elisheba gave birth to four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, all of whom were consecrated for the priesthood.

keyEvents.title: The tragedy of Nadab and Abihu
keyEvents.description: Elisheba experienced the sorrow of losing two of her sons, Nadab and Abihu, who died when they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord.
